# Supabase browser client

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.102.0 (MIT), downloaded from:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.102.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

It is stored locally so the PWA can initialize authentication and local data without a CDN connection. Update deliberately and verify the auth/password API compatibility.
